This cost is then assigned to both ending inventory and the cost of goods sold.

The recorded amount of inventory on hand using this method represents a value between the oldest and newest units purchased into stock.

It allows you to send messages that include pictures, video, or audio content to another device.
MMS messages can carry a larger size of content up to 300KB.
SMS is restricted to sending text-only messages, whereas MMS allows a combination of text, pictures, sounds, and videos.
